# Vento Labs

> Vento Labs is an AI automation agency (Vento Labs Pte. Ltd., registered in Singapore, UEN 202504485G, working remotely from Lisbon). We design and build custom AI agents that cut operating costs, automate workflows, and scale businesses without adding headcount. Every engagement starts with a free 2-week pilot: we build the first AI agent at no cost.

Key facts:
- Founded: 2025. Founder & lead engineer: Alexey Nagorny (alexey@ventolabs.com).
- Stack: Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph, CrewAI, n8n, Make.com, MCP servers. Self-hosted deployments — client data stays in the client's infrastructure.
- Typical timelines: basic AI agent in 3–7 days; process automation in 1–3 weeks; company-wide AI platform in 2–4 weeks.
- Typical running costs: AI model usage $20–200/month, paid directly to providers with no markup.
- AI Platform pricing: Pilot from $3,000 setup + $500/month; Scale from $8,000 setup + $2,000/month; Enterprise custom.
- Booking: https://cal.com/ventolabs/30min (30-minute discovery call, free).
- Languages: English (default), German (/de/), Spanish (/es/), Russian (/ru/).

## Services

- [AI Agents](https://ventolabs.com/services/ai-assistant/): Custom self-hosted AI agents on Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph, CrewAI. Telegram, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, email integration; computer-use; any LLM backend including local models.
- [AI Automation](https://ventolabs.com/services/ai-automation/): Intelligent workflow automation with n8n and Make.com — lead qualification, data sync, reporting, CRM/email/chat integrations.
- [AI Consulting & Training](https://ventolabs.com/services/ai-training/): Team enablement — Claude Code, Cursor, MCP servers setup; hands-on workshops; adoption measured at 30 and 60 days.
- [AI Platform](https://ventolabs.com/services/ai-workspace/): Company-wide AI operating system — dedicated agents per team, Knowledge Vault, role-based access, usage/ROI reporting.

## AI infrastructure

- [AI Data Centers](https://ventolabs.com/data-centers/): End-to-end development of AI data centers for investors and owners — deciding what to build, site search, securing land and grid capacity, transmission interconnection, modular construction, commissioning, and operation. Typical projects 10–100+ MW, phased. Modular deployment in 3–6 months against 24–36 for conventional construction; target PUE below 1.3; liquid-cooled racks up to 100 kW. Engagement structures: turnkey build you own, build-to-suit against a signed offtake, or joint venture. Sites currently in diligence or under evaluation in Texas, the US Midwest (MISO), and Sweden. Counterparty names, exact addresses, and commercial terms are not published — the underlying materials are under confidentiality agreements.

## Client results

- [Case studies](https://ventolabs.com/cases/): Zigmund Online (online therapy): patient response time cut from 4 hours to under 2 minutes, booking conversion +40%, 200+ conversations handled daily. NoConcept (e-commerce, 3,000+ SKUs): lead response 6 hours → 8 minutes, 25+ hours/week saved. ASG Compute (cloud infrastructure): 13 AI agents deployed across 5 departments in 4 weeks, AI spend −35%.
- [ArbitrAI](https://arbitrai.tech/): Vento Labs' own LegalTech product — an AI platform for Russian bankruptcy trustees (deadline control under the insolvency law, AI-drafted filings, transaction analysis). Results: daily deadline monitoring 2–3 hours → under 20 minutes, 99.9% of statutory publications filed on time, document prep 6× faster.

## Product directions

- [Content Factory](https://ventolabs.com/cases/content-factory/): Turns e-commerce catalogs into daily discovery content — lifestyle visuals, carousels, short videos, AI presenters.
- [Supplier Agent](https://ventolabs.com/cases/supplier-agent/): Reads supplier emails, chats and price lists; extracts SKUs, prices, stock; updates catalogs by rules with approval flows.
- [1C Agent](https://ventolabs.com/cases/erp-agent/): Permission-based AI layer over 1C ERP on Claude — faster development, safe manager actions, full audit trail (full case study in Russian at /ru/cases/erp-agent/).
- [Bankruptcy AI](https://ventolabs.com/cases/bankruptcy-agent/): AI platform for Russian arbitration trustees — procedural documents, deadline control, transaction analysis (page in Russian).

## Guides

Long-form engineering write-ups of work we actually ship — no gated PDFs, no lead-capture wall. Four are written in Russian because that is the market they address; every guide's URL is live in all four locales, with a localized summary stub where the full text isn't translated. Dates are publish dates.

- [Autonomous AI without delegating accountability](https://ventolabs.com/blog/autonomous-ai-accountability/) (2026-07-17, full text in EN/DE/ES/RU): You can delegate tasks and decision-making authority to an AI agent — not accountability. The five things every agent needs: scope, limits, approval points, an audit trail, and a named owner. Why "human in the loop" is not a control, and why controlled autonomy scales faster than unlimited autonomy.
- [Custom AI Agent Cost in 2026: An Honest Breakdown](https://ventolabs.com/blog/custom-ai-agent-cost/) (2026-07-16, EN): What a custom AI agent really costs — build and monthly run ranges from market data, no-code vs SaaS vs custom break-even math, and the hidden costs.
- [AI agent for 1C: capabilities, limits, rollout](https://ventolabs.com/blog/ai-agent-dlya-1c-vnedrenie/) (2026-07-16, RU): What an AI agent does on top of 1C:Enterprise — safe access architecture, honest limits, step-by-step rollout.
- [AI tooling for 1C: MCP servers, skills and plugins](https://ventolabs.com/blog/instrumenty-1c-claude-code-codex/) (2026-07-16, RU): A field guide to the AI tooling around 1C:Enterprise — MCP servers, Claude Code skills, the BSL Language Server plugin, and OpenAI Codex support.
- [AI agent for Wildberries and Ozon](https://ventolabs.com/blog/ai-agent-dlya-marketpleysov-wb-ozon/) (2026-07-16, RU): How an agent takes over seller routine on the two big Russian marketplaces — marketplace APIs, ETL into your own database, Telegram reports, honest limits.
- [AI for bankruptcy trustees](https://ventolabs.com/blog/ii-dlya-arbitrazhnogo-upravlyayushchego/) (2026-07-16, RU): What a bankruptcy AI agent already handles — deadlines, bank-statement screening, report drafts — and where the trustee's personal liability draws the line.
- [All guides](https://ventolabs.com/blog/)

## Company

- [Home](https://ventolabs.com/): The main entry point. Covers the offer (a free first AI agent, built after a 30-minute discovery call), the three-phase process — Audit (30-minute call to find where AI saves the most), Build (first agent connected to your tools and knowledge base, working in days), Scale (expansion by priority, each iteration with explicit KPIs) — research-backed ROI figures with their sources, the four service lines, client results, the founder Alexey Nagorny is the person you actually talk to on every call, and an FAQ covering hallucination risk, what data reaches external AI models, monthly running cost, implementation time, whether you can stop after the first setup, and industry fit.

## Machine-readable endpoints

- [Agent card (A2A)](https://ventolabs.com/.well-known/agent-card.json): nine delivery skills — the four services, data centers, and the four productized solutions — for agent-to-agent routing.
- [MCP server card](https://ventolabs.com/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): the in-page WebMCP surface (`navigator.modelContext`). A visiting agent can book a consultation or fetch contact details without leaving the page.
- [API catalog (RFC 9727)](https://ventolabs.com/.well-known/api-catalog): one entry, the public notify webhook, with its [OpenAPI 3.1 spec](https://ventolabs.com/.well-known/openapi/notify.json) and [human-readable docs](https://ventolabs.com/.well-known/api-docs/notify.html).
- [Agent Skills discovery index](https://ventolabs.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): intentionally an empty `skills` array. That index advertises downloadable `SKILL.md` procedure files for an agent to execute; Vento Labs publishes none. It is deliberately NOT a mirror of the nine A2A skills above — those describe work this company delivers, not instructions an agent can run. Do not treat the empty array as an oversight.
- [Sitemap](https://ventolabs.com/sitemap.xml)
